actions.add_addon_to_subscription.descri: Attach a recurring add-on to an account's current subscription. Different from Add Usage for Add-on, which only records consumption on a metered add-on already attached.
The UID of the account whose subscription will receive the add-on.
How often the add-on is billed. Defaults to Monthly.

actions.add_addon_usage.props.accountUid: The UID of the account to record usage for.

actions.add_invoice.props.description.de: Description for the invoice line item.

actions.add_reply.description: Add a reply to an existing support ticket (case) in Outseta.
actions.add_reply.props.agentName.descri: Name of the agent sending the reply.
actions.add_reply.props.caseUid.descript: The UID of the support ticket to reply to.

actions.cancel_subscription.props.cancel: If checked, the subscription is cancelled immediately. Otherwise it expires at the end of the current billing term.
actions.change_account_plan.description: Change an account's current subscription plan (upgrade, downgrade, or switch to free).
actions.change_account_plan.props.accoun: The UID of the account whose plan to change.

actions.create_account.props.clientIdent: A custom identifier you assign to this account (e.g. your internal customer ID).

auth.description:
Connect Activepieces to your Outseta account using the Admin API.

**To get your credentials:**
1. Log in to your Outseta account
2. Go to **Settings → Integrations → API**
3. Copy your **API Key** and **API Secret**
4. Your domain is your Outseta subdomain, e.g. `https://yourcompany.outseta.com`

Need help? See [Outseta API docs](https://documenter.getpostman.com/view/3613332/outseta-rest-api-v1).
auth.props.apiKey.description: Found in Outseta → Settings → Integrations → API
auth.props.apiSecret.description: Found alongside your API Key in Outseta → Settings → Integrations → API
auth.props.domain.description: Your full Outseta domain URL, e.g. https://yourcompany.outseta.com

triggers.new_account_event.description: Triggers on account-scoped events (lifecycle, stage, billing, subscription, invoice).
triggers.new_account_event.props.eventSu: Select one or more account-scoped events to listen for. Configure a matching Outseta notification for each, all pointing to this webhook URL.
triggers.new_account_event.props.setup.d:
- In Outseta, go to **Settings → Notifications → Add Notification**.
- Select the account event and paste the webhook URL in the callback field:
